item.title: Samsung Opens Preorders for Android XR Smart Glasses Starting at $395
item.description:
Samsung has opened preorders in Korea and the US for Intelligent Eyewear, its first smart glasses, shipping December 10 at $395 to $489 across 30 designs co-developed with Gentle Monster and Warby Parker. Running Android XR with deep Gemini integration, the glasses target navigation, live translation and visual assistance.

原文标题：三星首款智能眼镜开启预售 395 美元起搭载 Android XR

Why it matters：这是 Android XR 生态首款面向消费市场的智能眼镜落地，标志着 Gemini 从手机走向可穿戴形态。

item.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO, Shares Fall 10% Pre-Market
item.description:
Jensen Huang has stepped down as Nvidia CEO and left its board after 33 years, three days after the board opened an outside probe into reports he was a foreign intelligence target. CFO Colette Kress becomes interim CEO and director Harvey Jones becomes the company's first board chair; shares fell about 10% pre-market, extending two weeks of losses to roughly $1.4T. Huang resisted succession planning, leaving dozens of direct reports and no clear No. 2, while the next CEO inherits about $100B in investments including a planned $10B Anthropic share purchase at its IPO next week.

原文标题：黄仁勋辞任英伟达 CEO 股价盘前跌 10%

Why it matters：全球最重要算力公司的最高层突发更替，直接牵动 AI 芯片供应、千亿美元投资版图与 Anthropic 上市节奏。

item.description:
Nvidia announced that Jensen Huang has stepped down immediately as president, CEO and board member, with CFO Colette Kress taking over as interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor. The company confirmed its fiscal 2027 third-quarter earnings will still be released on November 17 as originally scheduled, and named former Synopsys CEO Harvey Jones as its first-ever board chair.

item.title: AMD Architect Details Zen 6 and Zen 6c Core Family Evolution
item.description:
AMD chief architect Mike Clark detailed the Zen 6 and Zen 6c dual-core-family design in an in-depth interview, explaining how AMD shifted from density-as-area-play toward workload-differentiated cores since Zen 4 and what drove the divergence between Zen 6 and Zen 6c. The conversation is a key first-hand source for understanding AMD's next-generation CPU roadmap.

item.title: LibreAGI Launches Private BitTorrent Tracker to Preserve Open Model Weights
item.description:
LibreAGI is a members-only private BitTorrent tracker where members seed copies of open model weights most likely to disappear, earning credit weighted by scarcity. It accepts only safetensors and GGUF files under Apache-2.0, MIT or the Qwen Community License, verifies each file against its source commit, and publishes a signed public catalog so the swarms can be rebuilt if the site goes away.

原文标题：LibreAGI 推出私有 BT 网络备份开源模型权重

Why it matters：以去中心化做种机制应对开源模型下架风险，是开源模型长期保存与分发的一次具体工程尝试。

item.title: JD.com Completes 1.335 Billion Euro Ceconomy Takeover
item.description:
JD.com has completed its tender offer for German consumer electronics retailer Ceconomy, acquiring 59.8% of shares and voting rights for EUR 1.335 billion and making Ceconomy a subsidiary. Combined with partner Convergenta's retained 25.3% stake, the two hold 85.2% of the company. Ceconomy operates over 1,000 MediaMarkt and Saturn stores across 11 countries, and JD.com says it will keep independent operations and its local technology stack unchanged.

原文标题：京东 13.35 亿欧元收购 Ceconomy 59.8% 股权

Why it matters：中国电商巨头以十亿欧元级资金控股欧洲线下零售网络，是跨境零售与渠道格局的重要产业事件。

item.title: ElevenLabs Releases Scribe v3 Speech Recognition Models
item.description:
ElevenLabs has launched Scribe v3 and Scribe v3 Live, speech recognition models for pre-recorded and real-time audio, tuned for messy conditions such as crosstalk and background noise. The live version uses conversational context to avoid cutting callers off during brief pauses. Artificial Analysis benchmarks place Scribe v3 among the most accurate transcription models, though it is slower and pricier than rivals from Microsoft and xAI.

原文标题：ElevenLabs 发布 Scribe v3 语音识别模型

Why it matters：语音识别是语音智能体的关键底座，实时上下文断句能力与准确率、成本权衡值得关注。

The model understands speech end-to-end instead of the cascaded transcribe-then-reason pipeline, covering 99 languages and 202 dialects across transcription, translation, speaker diarization, emotion analysis and audio QA, and is trained entirely on domestic compute.

item.title: UnionPay and Ant Group Launch All-in-One Payment Terminal
item.description:
UnionPay and Ant Group unveiled an all-in-one payment terminal in Xi'an that accepts Alipay Tap, domestic and international bank cards, QR codes, mobile Pay and digital yuan on a single device. The terminal aims to cut merchants' multi-device overhead and improve payment accessibility for inbound tourists and elderly users. Alipay Tap has reached 2,200 scenarios, 30 million offline touchpoints and 400 million users since launching in July 2024.

item.description:
Google DeepMind has released AlphaGenome 2, advancing genomics AI from bulk-tissue predictions to single-cell-type resolution for forecasting genetic variant effects in specific human cell types. In testing it surfaced nearly twice as many relevant gene variants as its predecessor and is now available for noncommercial research.

item.title: Asus Posts NT$50.5B Nine-Month Profit as AI Server Revenue Doubles
item.description:

Third-quarter server revenue more than doubled and AI PC revenue grew over 100%, lifting brand operating profit by 161%. However, delayed customer data-center buildouts pushed some server orders into Q4, while inventory rose 36% sequentially and bank borrowings jumped 150%.

item.title: Ex-ByteDance Executive Chen Lin Returns with AI Education Startup Galaxy Zhixue
item.description:

The system pairs the Doubao foundation model with a self-developed learning engine built on deep knowledge tracing, item response theory and cognitive diagnosis, aiming to diagnose how students learn rather than merely generate solutions. item.title: JPMorgan Forecasts US Humanoid Robot Output of 400,000 Units by 2030
item.description:
JPMorgan projects US humanoid robot output will reach 300,000 to 400,000 units by 2030 and about 1.5 million by 2035, driven by labor shortages and falling costs. The report flags dexterous hands, actuators, robot brains and production capacity as key bottlenecks, noting most US makers target only 10,000 to 30,000 units annually and that component suppliers offer better near-term investment opportunities than OEMs.

item.title: Australia Drafts Law Mandating Independent Safety Audits for Frontier AI Models
item.description:
Australia's Albanese government unveiled its first mandatory safety law for frontier AI models, requiring developers to submit to independent audits, run continuous safety checks, publish safety frameworks, and report incidents immediately. A new oversight body will enforce compliance alongside the Australian AI Safety Institute with steep penalties, with details to follow public consultation.

item.title: Grok Build Apps Expose 35,000 Unauthenticated Endpoints
item.description:
Security firm Claroc found that over 35,000 apps built with Grok are accessible without authentication, with roughly 650 to 800 containing private data, including internal sales tools and employee performance records from SpaceXSI, X and Tesla, plus ICU patient records and plaintext credentials. The root cause is that Grok assigns each app a hard-to-guess random subdomain but relies on obscurity rather than real access control. Apps created by SpaceXSI and X employees have been taken offline, while many third-party apps remain exposed.

原文标题：Grok 构建应用泄露 3.5 万个未授权访问入口

Why it matters：头部 AI 编程平台出现大规模鉴权缺失导致真实机密外泄，是 AI 应用安全范式的标志性事件。
